143   // ---------------
144   // Generate Lanes
145   // ---------------
146   for (genvar lane = 0; lane < int'(NUM_LANES); lane++) begin : gen_num_lanes
147     localparam int unsigned LANE = unsigned'(lane); // unsigned to please the linter
148     // Get a mask of active formats for this lane
149     localparam fpnew_pkg::fmt_logic_t ACTIVE_FORMATS =
150         fpnew_pkg::get_lane_formats(Width, FpFmtConfig, LANE);
151     localparam fpnew_pkg::ifmt_logic_t ACTIVE_INT_FORMATS =
152         fpnew_pkg::get_lane_int_formats(Width, FpFmtConfig, IntFmtConfig, LANE);
153     localparam int unsigned MAX_WIDTH = fpnew_pkg::max_fp_width(ACTIVE_FORMATS);
154 
155     // Cast-specific parameters
156     localparam fpnew_pkg::fmt_logic_t CONV_FORMATS =
157         fpnew_pkg::get_conv_lane_formats(Width, FpFmtConfig, LANE);
158     localparam fpnew_pkg::ifmt_logic_t CONV_INT_FORMATS =
159         fpnew_pkg::get_conv_lane_int_formats(Width, FpFmtConfig, IntFmtConfig, LANE);
160     localparam int unsigned CONV_WIDTH = fpnew_pkg::max_fp_width(CONV_FORMATS);
161 
162     // Lane parameters from Opgroup
163     localparam fpnew_pkg::fmt_logic_t LANE_FORMATS = (OpGroup == fpnew_pkg::CONV)
164                                                      ? CONV_FORMATS : ACTIVE_FORMATS;
165     localparam int unsigned LANE_WIDTH = (OpGroup == fpnew_pkg::CONV) ? CONV_WIDTH : MAX_WIDTH;
166 
167     logic [LANE_WIDTH-1:0] local_result; // lane-local results
168 
169     // Generate instances only if needed, lane 0 always generated
170     if ((lane == 0) || EnableVectors) begin : active_lane
171       logic in_valid, out_valid, out_ready; // lane-local handshake
172 
173       logic [NUM_OPERANDS-1:0][LANE_WIDTH-1:0] local_operands;  // lane-local oprands
174       logic [LANE_WIDTH-1:0]                   op_result;       // lane-local results
175       fpnew_pkg::status_t                      op_status;
176 
177       assign in_valid = in_valid_i & ((lane == 0) | vectorial_op); // upper lanes only for vectors
178 
179       // Slice out the operands for this lane, upper bits are ignored in the unit
180       always_comb begin : prepare_input
181         for (int unsigned i = 0; i < NUM_OPERANDS; i++) begin
182           local_operands[i] = operands_i[i] >> LANE*fpnew_pkg::fp_width(src_fmt_i);
183         end
184         // override operand 0 for some conversions
185         if (OpGroup == fpnew_pkg::CONV) begin
186           // Source is an integer
187           if (op_i == fpnew_pkg::I2F) begin
188             local_operands[0] = operands_i[0] >> LANE*fpnew_pkg::int_width(int_fmt_i);
189           // vectorial F2F up casts
190           end else if (op_i == fpnew_pkg::F2F) begin
191             if (vectorial_op && op_mod_i && is_up_cast) begin // up cast with upper half
192               local_operands[0] = operands_i[0] >> LANE*fpnew_pkg::fp_width(src_fmt_i) +
193                                                    MAX_FP_WIDTH/2;
194             end
195           // CPK
196           end else if (dst_is_cpk) begin
197             if (lane == 1) begin
198               local_operands[0] = operands_i[1][LANE_WIDTH-1:0]; // using opB as second argument
199             end
200           end
201         end
202       end
